name: Titles And Names Of The Wicked
overview: Scripture reveals that the wicked are often identified by titles emphasizing their opposition to God and their corrupt nature. They are described as 'children of Belial' who forsake the Lord to serve other gods, as well as 'children in whom is no faith,' highlighting their spiritual rebellion and untrustworthiness. Their perverse and crooked generation is marked by a defilement that separates them from the true children of God. Ultimately, the adversaries of the Lord face divine judgment, as God promises to break them and uphold His anointed, demonstrating His sovereign justice against wickedness.
